79294.subject: 🔷 The Daily: The SEC makes its move on tokenized stocks
79294.body:
Regulators keep moving on crypto: CFTC follows SEC with developer-friendly no-action stance | 'Not the end': Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats still committed to passing Clarity Act | House committee moves to codify Trump's Strategic Bitcoin Reserve | Grayscale's Pandl still sees bitcoin's $58K low as the bottom, gives clients 'green light' |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented By:

( https://bron.org/?utm_source=TheBlock&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=DailyNewsletter&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Thursday! Crypto markets have absorbed the failed *Clarity Act* vote and a *Federal Reserve* rate hike without a deeper selloff, with analysts at *LMAX Group* , *Nansen* , and *Wintermute* noting the resilient price action but warning fresh catalysts are needed.

In today's newsletter, the *SEC* releases its long-awaited innovation exemption, the *CFTC* follows with a developer-friendly no-action position, *Sen. Gillibrand* says *Democrats* are still committed to passing the *Clarity Act* , and more.

Meanwhile, *Bitwise* CIO *Matt Hougan* revises ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-17-bitwise-cio-hougan-revises-clarity-act-outlook-says-crypto-bull-market-may-continue-without-legislation-415339?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) his *Clarity Act* outlook, saying the crypto bull market may continue without legislation.

*P.S.* Don't forget to catch *The Starting Block* live ( https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2100603819696484564?s=20&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) at day two of the *Avalanche Summit* in New York!

*THE BIG ONE*

*🏛️ SEC releases long-awaited innovation exemption to 'bring America's capital markets into the digital age'*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-09-17-sec-releases-innovation-exemption-415324?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

The *SEC* released its long-awaited "innovation exemption" on Thursday, positioning it as a direct response to the *Senate's* failure to advance the *Clarity Act*.

* Chair *Paul Atkins* said the measure will "bring America's capital markets into the digital age" by allowing onchain trading of certain tokenized stocks.
* The five-year exemption takes effect immediately, with a comment period open and more permanent rulemaking to follow.
* It exempts certain "tokenized securities venues" from being classified as exchanges, and specific liquidity providers from dealer rules when they trade or provide liquidity through automated market makers.

79271.subject: 🟪 NEWS: Blockworks introduces Agentic Detection
79271.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/38f19638-14d6-4f17-8f68-5ae4d2eedf64/Agentic-Detection-202609d_Website_Article-Image-02.jpg?t=1789614735)
Caption: 



Customers of [Blockworks Monitoring](https://blockworks.com/products/monitoring) can now receive real-time alerts the moment our agents identify them, without waiting for an analyst to review. Customers get immediate visibility into a wider range of activity across the assets they follow.

When an exchange lists an asset, it takes on a responsibility that extends far beyond launch day. A security incident can demand an immediate response. A token migration can require coordination across the business. Keeping up with that activity across hundreds of assets takes constant attention, and even a team with endless resources will miss key updates.

Agentic Detection closes that gap. Within seconds of an event, it tells you what happened, which assets or organizations are involved, and where the information came from. Before an alert reaches your team, Monitoring filters the source material, connects related reporting, and organizes the findings with the original sources attached, so you can examine the evidence yourself.

Until now, every alert needed analyst approval before it reached customers. Analysts had to prioritize what they reviewed, and updates took minutes instead of seconds. Agentic Detection makes our findings available immediately.

Our mission at Blockworks is to build trust in onchain markets. For the exchanges, brokerages, and institutions supporting these markets, that trust depends on work that continues long after an asset is listed. Agentic Detection gives teams a wider view of those assets and more time to respond as they change.

To see how Monitoring can support your team, [contact Blockworks for a demo](https://blockworks.com/contact).

_P.S. To learn more, read our _[_launch announcement._](https://blockworks.com/insights/introducing-agentic-detection-asset-monitoring-built-for-the-ai-era)
